description: This file defines configurations and initialization routines for a Toyota JZS147 engine within an engine control software. It includes engine specifications, pin assignments, thermistor configuration, and different setup functions for variations like VVTi and non-VVTi versions.

methods.name: void common2jz(DECLARE_ENGINE_PARAMETER_SIGNATURE)
methods.description: Sets common engine parameters for the Toyota JZS147 engine, including engine specs, pin configurations, thermistor setup, and fuel injector flow rate.

methods.name: void setToyota_jzs147EngineConfiguration(DECLARE_ENGINE_PARAMETER_SIGNATURE)
methods.description: Configures the engine for a standard JZS147 engine, setting operation mode and trigger type, with some commented-out code for alternative configurations.

methods.name: void setToyota_2jz_vics(DECLARE_ENGINE_PARAMETER_SIGNATURE)
methods.description: Configures the engine with VICS (Variable Intake Control System) enabled, setting specific trigger type, input pins, and VVT mode.
